description:
Create layers/auth/stores/auth-slideover.ts merging useAuthSlideover (open/close via URL query) and useSignInProvider (multi-stage sign-in state) into a single Pinia setup store.

### Scope
- Store manages: isOpen, stage (enter-credential, confirm-otp, enter-password, forgot-password, reset-password), credential, signInResponse, error state.
- Expose actions: openSlideover(redirectTo?, prefill?), closeSlideover(), submitCredential(), confirmOtp(), etc.
- Keep URL query sync (authSlideover=open) as a watcher inside the store.
- Export the store from layers/auth composables index for cross-layer access.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. Store file created and exports defineStore with setup syntax.
2. All state and actions from useSignInProvider + useAuthSlideover are covered.
3. Store supports optional phone pre-fill and starting at a specific stage.
4. Existing provide/inject pattern is NOT removed yet (coexistence).
title: Create auth slideover Pinia store

description:
Update all auth layer components to consume the new auth-slideover Pinia store instead of provide/inject.

### Scope
- AuthSlideover.vue: replace useSignInProvider() call with useAuthSlideoverStore(). Remove provide().
- UnifiedSignInForm.vue: replace useSignIn() inject with store.
- ConfirmOtpForm.vue: same.
- EnterPasswordForm.vue: same.
- ForgotPasswordForm.vue: same.
- ResetPasswordForm.vue: same.
- app/app.vue: verify AuthSlideover still works at root (should be simpler now).

### Acceptance Criteria
1. All auth stage components use the Pinia store.
2. provide/inject pattern (useSignInProvider, useSignIn) is removed from auth layer.
3. Auth flow works end-to-end: open slideover → enter phone → OTP → password → signed in.
4. No regressions in existing auth entry points (header button, middleware redirect).
title: Refactor auth components to use Pinia store

description:
Create layers/crm/stores/car-request.ts extracting useCarRequestForm from provide/inject to a Pinia setup store.

### Scope
- Store manages: stage (form | success), form state (phone, name, etc.), vehicle context (direct vs all-offers, vehicleId, brandId), successData (CreateLeadResponse), mutation loading/error.
- Expose actions: open(props), close(), submitForm(), resetForm().
- The open() action sets vehicle context and resets stage to 'form'.
- Keep the useMutation from @tanstack/vue-query inside the store.
- useCarRequestSlideover.ts thin wrapper calls useOverlay().create() and store.open().

### Acceptance Criteria
1. Store file created with defineStore setup syntax in layers/crm/stores/.
2. All state from useCarRequestForm is moved to the store.
3. successData comes from actual mutation response (remove hardcoded mock).
4. Existing provide/inject is NOT removed yet (coexistence for safe migration).
title: Create CRM car-request Pinia store

description:
Update CRM layer components to consume the new car-request Pinia store instead of provide/inject.

### Scope
- CarRequestSlideover.vue: replace useCarRequestForm() with useCarRequestStore(). Remove provide(). Read stage, successData, vehicle context from store.
- RequestForm.vue: replace useCarRequestFormContext() inject with useCarRequestStore(). Bind form fields and submit to store actions.
- RequestSuccessState.vue: read successData props from parent (which reads from store).

### Acceptance Criteria
1. All CRM components use the Pinia store for state.
2. provide/inject pattern (useCarRequestForm, useCarRequestFormContext) is removed.
3. Car request form submits successfully and transitions to success stage.
4. Success state shows correct data from API response.
title: Refactor CRM components to use Pinia store

description:
Implement the cross-layer handoff: when a guest submits a car request and sees the success state, the 'Увійти в кабінет' CTA should close the CRM slideover and open the auth slideover pre-filled with the phone number at the OTP stage.

### Scope
- In CarRequestSlideover (or RequestSuccessState navigate handler): call carRequestStore.close(), then authSlideoverStore.openSlideover({ prefill: phone, stage: 'confirm-otp' }).
- Auth store openSlideover() must accept optional prefill phone and starting stage.
- Verify the auth slideover opens with phone pre-filled and OTP input focused.
- Handle edge case: if user is already logged in, the CTA should navigate to /profile/offers instead.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. Guest flow: submit request → success state → tap CTA → CRM closes → auth opens at OTP stage with phone pre-filled.
2. Logged-in flow: submit request → success state → tap CTA → navigates to /profile/offers.
3. No concurrent slideovers visible (CRM fully closes before auth opens).
4. Matches all 4 Figma variants (all-offers guest, all-offers logged, this-offer guest, this-offer logged).
title: Wire CRM-to-Auth navigation handoff

description:
Remove legacy provide/inject code and unused files after Pinia migration is complete and verified.

### Scope
- Delete layers/profile/stores/sign-in-modal.ts (superseded by auth-slideover store).
- Remove InjectionKey, provide(), inject() remnants from auth composables.
- Remove useCarRequestFormContext InjectionKey and provide/inject from CRM composables.
- Clean up TODO comments added during migration.
- Verify no dead imports or unused exports remain.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. No provide/inject patterns remain in auth or CRM layers for slideover state.
2. sign-in-modal.ts is deleted.
3. Linter passes with no unused import warnings.
4. All auth and CRM flows still work after cleanup.
title: Cleanup legacy auth/CRM state management
